about: Corrections to the mod families refresh derives from DE data (V4; rule in app/data/build/families.py). `join` merges mods the data does not link, `split` takes mods out of their derived family. Each entry: id, mods (uniqueNames), names, reason, verified (checked in the arsenal or on a saved wiki page).

join.reason: cannot be equipped together (also joins their pistol/shotgun counterparts, which never meet across classes)
